patch_description: The redesign replaces per-window independent averaging with a causal adaptive trend-estimation pipeline. A robust constant-velocity Kalman tracker provides low-lag state estimation, while a robust exponentially weighted local-regression stage estimates the current endpoint trend from each sliding window. Their adaptive fusion reduces noise-induced reversals without introducing the large phase delay of a conventional moving average. The code is organized into reusable estimator components, a window-output adapter, and separate metric/reporting stages while preserving all original public function inputs and outputs.
